answer: Newcomers cross the ridge only through a vouch-slot: a member spends one of five slots and locks a 60 credit ferrous bond for the newcomer, cipher receipt binding one voucher to one identity. Slots thaw one per member per epoch, and a proven fake burns the bond and the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 vouchers and 60,000 locked credits; renting vouchers fails because the voucher pays for the fake. An honest agent costs one slot, once.
